keyPoints: Amal (acid) khatta hota hai aur neele litmus kagaz ko laal kar deta hai — jaise nimbu me citric acid.
Kshaar (base) kadva hota hai aur laal litmus ko neela kar deta hai — jaise sabun.
pH scale 0 se 14 tak: 7 se kam amaliya, 7 udaseen (neutral), 7 se zyada kshaariya.
Amal + kshaar -> lavan (salt) + paani — ise udaseenikaran (neutralisation) kehte hain.
Dhatu + amal -> lavan + hydrogen gas nikalti hai.
Rozmarra me: khane ka soda (baking soda), dhone ka soda (washing soda), pet ki jalan me antacid.
Sanket (indicators) jaise litmus, haldi aur methyl orange amal-kshaar me rang badal dete hain.
subject: Science
title: Amal, Kshaar aur Lavan
